notes: The q=3,5,7 histograms are finite exact computations. The separately bound DRAFT proof establishes the displayed a_D^2, a_D^4, a_D^2*b_D, b_D, b_D^2, and K_D formulas, including the normalized toy-minor first-moment limit, for every odd prime power; the separately replayed affine packet proves the exact action law and finite orbit partitions only at q=3,5,7. scope_boundary: Exhaustive histograms only for q=3,5,7, plus proof-backed b_D and toy-minor first moments, second/fourth trace moments, and the mixed a_D^2*b_D moment for every odd prime power, with the consequent negative-sign density floor. The exact affine action law is replayed with complete orbit partitions only at q=3,5,7; no full sign law, asymptotic orbit law, or all-q second-moment formula follows from the separately replayed PARTIAL reduction roadmap. theorem_links.scope: Proved in the bound DRAFT research note for every odd prime power by an exact squarefree-Moebius character-correlation calculation.
The normalized first moment tends to -1 immediately from the exact formula; this is not a higher-moment equidistribution theorem.
Ordered-linear reweighting of the proved quartic character table gives E[a_D^4]=3q^2-7q+5+12/q-14/q^2-11/q^3 for every odd prime power.
The three degree-two factorization types give E[b_D]=q-1+(q^2-1)/q^3 for every odd prime power.
Quartic-row reweighting gives the displayed exact E[a_D^2*b_D] formula for every odd prime power.
The proved a_D^2, b_D, b_D^2, a_D^2*b_D, and a_D^4 formulas isolate five exact low-weight character means through chi_(4,0).
For every odd prime power, the exact first moment and exact lower range bound give rho_-(q)>=P(q)/(20*q^5) and liminf rho_-(q)>=1/20; this is not a sign law.

The exact master identity, 20+54 signature census, six primitive-coefficient families, and refined honest high-weight USp(4) obstruction are replayed. M22 and B4 are not evaluated for every odd prime power.
